title: Garden expansion candidates
note: These 200 concepts are unimplemented design candidates. Each needs deeper design, feasibility work and deduplication against the evolving game before implementation.
scopeNote: The catalogue excludes the current Listening Walk, shared wind-kite activity and rain-refuge work, and avoids simple particle, coin, badge or cosmetic variants as standalone concepts.
designPrinciples: Keep the calm, optional nature of the garden and avoid missed-day punishment.
Keep persistent outcomes under the existing owner and host authority model.
Design meaningful solo access and clear visitor permissions alongside shared play.
Preserve reduced-motion and non-audio ways to understand essential information.
Use bounded retained rendering and simulation appropriate to the browser engine.

concepts.title: The root-network atlas
concepts.playerExperience: Trace connected roots beneath mature trees to navigate an underground network whose passages reflect the actual orchard above.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can survey separate branches and combine their route sketches at the surface.

concepts.title: The hand-pulled chain ferry
concepts.playerExperience: Pull a ferry across a narrow inlet while choosing when to release the chain and let the current carry it.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: One passenger can handle the chain while another watches the landing and gives clear signals.

concepts.title: The hillside funicular
concepts.playerExperience: Restore a counterbalanced hillside railway and operate its passing loop to reach gardens on several terraces.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can coordinate the two cars or ride together while one operates the station controls.

concepts.title: The river below the garden
concepts.playerExperience: Explore a branching underground river by matching surface streams to cave channels and choosing safe mooring points.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A shore navigator can read surface measurements while a boat crew maps the caves.

concepts.title: The wind-powered ridge lift
concepts.playerExperience: Adjust a wind-powered lift to carry yourself and a modest load between sheltered ledges without losing the return route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A friend can operate the ground controls while the rider chooses a landing.

concepts.title: Inside the fallen giant
concepts.playerExperience: Enter a huge fallen tree and find connected chambers formed by roots, old nests and weathered hollows.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can open passages from different entrances and meet in the central hollow.

concepts.title: The tower of moving views
concepts.playerExperience: Rotate a tower room to line up narrow viewing slots with distant landmarks and reveal a route across the valley.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Observers at the landmarks can supply the missing alignment information.

concepts.title: The exposed riverbed
concepts.playerExperience: Investigate an old riverbed as falling water reveals structures in their original positions instead of scattering loose treasure.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can map different exposed sections before assembling the settlement plan.

concepts.title: The abandoned inspection railway
concepts.playerExperience: Drive a small inspection trolley through overgrown rail branches, repairing switches to reconnect isolated parts of the garden.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Passengers can manage signals and cargo while the driver controls the trolley.

concepts.title: The model borough
concepts.playerExperience: Step into a scale-changing model village where familiar garden objects become streets, buildings and climbing routes.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players at normal and miniature scales can cooperate through carefully limited object interactions.

concepts.title: The geode fracture labyrinth
concepts.playerExperience: Read the matching fracture faces of a giant geode to work out which crystalline chambers connect through its interior.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Explorers can compare drawings of chamber boundaries from opposite entrances.

concepts.title: The cliffside basket route
concepts.playerExperience: Send carefully packed survey equipment through a network of cliff baskets and follow its route to an unreachable camp.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can receive, repack and redirect loads from different cliff stations.

concepts.title: The courtyard of borrowed shadows
concepts.playerExperience: Reposition a courtyard model so real architectural shadows reveal a walkable pattern across its stone floor.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can stand at different viewing points and describe the parts hidden from the operator.

concepts.title: The unfinished expedition
concepts.playerExperience: Reconstruct an explorer's route from camp layouts, damaged equipment and geographical observations rather than a sequence of map markers.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Each visitor can contribute an observation to the shared expedition chart.

concepts.title: The canopy traverse
concepts.playerExperience: Plan a route through connected tree crowns using rope spans, branch clearances and quiet wildlife observation platforms.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can travel by separate branches and operate paired platforms.

concepts.title: The museum under the village
concepts.playerExperience: Excavate a buried street as a continuous place and preserve its rooms in position as a walk-through historical exhibit.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Groups can work on separate rooms while an owner chooses what remains covered or displayed.

concepts.title: The orbital garden
concepts.playerExperience: Move miniature planets around a large physical garden model to understand and open its changing paths.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can control different orbital arms and coordinate alignments.

concepts.title: The belay ridge
concepts.playerExperience: Explore a high ridge by placing reliable rope anchors and choosing a route with a clearly preserved way down.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A companion can hold a belay or scout the next anchor from a nearby ledge.

concepts.title: The sleeping stone giant
concepts.playerExperience: Explore a landscape-sized stone figure and restore its internal mechanisms until its hands form new bridges.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Different teams can work inside separate limbs before coordinating the final movement.

concepts.title: The lost viewpoints
concepts.playerExperience: Match historical garden pictures to present-day viewpoints and use their parallax to locate vanished paths and structures.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can hold reference frames at different positions and compare alignments.

concepts.title: The uncharted lake archipelago
concepts.playerExperience: Chart an interconnected chain of lake islands by measuring landmarks, currents and safe distances from your boat.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A crew can divide navigation, rowing and chart annotation.

concepts.title: The boundary palimpsest
concepts.playerExperience: Compare old boundary stones with living hedges to uncover how the garden changed shape across several eras.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can survey separate boundaries and assemble competing historical maps.

concepts.title: The sounding well
concepts.playerExperience: Lower interchangeable instruments into a deep well to map its chambers and discover a concealed maintenance passage.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can compare surface measurements with observations from the lower chamber.

concepts.title: The dormant seed vault
concepts.playerExperience: Open a historical seed vault by reconstructing the temperature and moisture conditions described by its surviving instruments.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can operate separate climate controls and read different instrument panels.

concepts.title: The ruins seen only in reflection
concepts.playerExperience: Use pools and polished stones to map a ruined structure whose hidden geometry is visible only from reflected viewpoints.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A partner can mark positions in the physical world while another reads the reflection.

concepts.title: The magnetic courtyard
concepts.playerExperience: Learn how buried iron changes your compass and use controlled magnetic interference to trace a hidden courtyard route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can carry reference compasses outside the interference field.

concepts.title: The wind-cut canyon
concepts.playerExperience: Cross a narrow canyon by reading wind shadows, choosing sheltered rests and operating old folding windbreaks.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Partners can open windbreaks from opposite sides while keeping a return passage available.

concepts.title: The invisible printing house
concepts.playerExperience: Recover a printing house's layered maps by combining ink, pressure and transparent plates in the correct physical arrangement.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can align separate print layers and compare the resulting route.

concepts.title: The clockwork causeway
concepts.playerExperience: Reconfigure a causeway of rotating stone sections to create a continuous route while retaining a safe standing platform.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate remote gearing that the traveler cannot reach directly.

concepts.title: The walking island
concepts.playerExperience: Discover that a tiny island is a gentle moving creature and learn its travel pattern to visit places along its route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can compare observations from shore and from the moving island.

concepts.title: The sunken conservatory
concepts.playerExperience: Explore a submerged glasshouse using a tethered air bell, reading its planting records to reopen connected underwater rooms.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A surface partner can operate the air bell and manage the guide rope.

concepts.title: The mosaic bridge
concepts.playerExperience: Reconstruct an outdoor bridge from surviving mosaic directions and landscape sightlines rather than simply donating building materials.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can examine either bank and agree on how the missing sections fit.

concepts.title: The compartment greenhouse
concepts.playerExperience: Create adjoining greenhouse climates and observe how opening vents and moving shade changes the communities living inside.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can tend different compartments and compare the connected results.

concepts.title: The migration observatory
concepts.playerExperience: Recognize individual migrating birds and prepare useful resting habitats along the routes they actually choose.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A shared migration record can connect sightings from several gardens without requiring simultaneous visits.

concepts.title: The graft-family orchard
concepts.playerExperience: Build an orchard of documented rootstock and scion relationships, then observe how each graft changes growth and flowering.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Gardeners can exchange explicitly identified cuttings and compare their growing conditions.

concepts.title: The habitat field station
concepts.playerExperience: Run small reversible habitat experiments and learn from visible animal choices instead of receiving an unexplained attraction bonus.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can maintain different comparison plots and pool their observations.

concepts.title: The mycelium underworld
concepts.playerExperience: Reveal a living fungal network and guide beneficial connections between trees by changing the ground conditions above it.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can work on different surface patches while watching the same underground response.

concepts.title: The beaver wetland
concepts.playerExperience: Make room for a beaver colony whose dams gradually reshape side channels, wet meadows and accessible observation routes.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help redirect overflow through owner-approved channels.

concepts.title: The bird territory mosaic
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange perches and vegetation so neighboring birds establish compatible territories with visible boundaries and changing songs.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can design adjoining habitat sections and observe how their boundaries interact.

concepts.title: The bee foraging language
concepts.playerExperience: Watch bees communicate useful flower routes and improve the route network through planting choices rather than repeated harvesting.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can compare foraging paths between connected flower patches.

concepts.title: The changing pond community
concepts.playerExperience: Guide a pond from open water to a layered wetland by balancing light, aquatic plants and natural filtration.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Different gardeners can propose and tend complementary habitat zones.

concepts.title: Companion apprenticeships
concepts.playerExperience: Teach a pet a useful multi-step garden routine through demonstrations while its species and preferences affect how it performs it.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A trusted visitor can assist a demonstration without taking control of the owner's pet.

concepts.title: Pets with social lives
concepts.playerExperience: Help persistent pets develop friendships, shared games and preferred meeting places through repeated voluntary encounters.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visiting companions can form relationships that continue across later visits.

concepts.title: The companion body-language book
concepts.playerExperience: Learn a pet's contextual gestures well enough to respond to its intentions without turning every interaction into a text menu.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can learn the same gestures and coordinate their responses around shared activities.

concepts.title: The scent garden
concepts.playerExperience: Plant a connected scent landscape and follow how wind carries different trails that your companion can interpret.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: One player can read a companion's responses while another adjusts a scent source.

concepts.title: The nest architects
concepts.playerExperience: Provide varied natural building materials and watch birds choose, transport and assemble them into distinct functional nests.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute different materials while the resident gardener controls placement.

concepts.title: The seed-carrier web
concepts.playerExperience: Observe where animals cache seeds and decide which unexpected seedlings become part of the future garden.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can document cache locations without disturbing another gardener's choices.

concepts.title: A dragonfly's whole life
concepts.playerExperience: Follow a recognizable dragonfly from pond larva through emergence and adult flight by maintaining suitable connected habitats.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can observe different stages and contribute to one shared natural-history account.

concepts.title: The tortoise landscape routes
concepts.playerExperience: Reshape a gentle garden route around a tortoise's chosen destinations, resting rocks and seasonal preferences.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can prepare different parts of its continuous route and watch it make its own choices.

concepts.title: The grazing meadow mosaic
concepts.playerExperience: Guide a small grazing herd to create varied grass heights that support different plants and wildlife.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can move temporary barriers and guide the herd from separate positions.

concepts.title: The connected wildlife corridors
concepts.playerExperience: Link fragmented habitats with safe tunnels, canopy spans and ground cover that animals visibly learn to use.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Neighbors can plan compatible corridor ends across their visiting routes.

concepts.title: The compost food web
concepts.playerExperience: Manage a visible decomposer community whose layers change as you vary the mixture, moisture and turning of a compost system.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can compare different compost recipes and observe their inhabitants together.

concepts.title: Canopy light gardening
concepts.playerExperience: Prune and train tree crowns to create a moving mosaic of light that changes what can flourish beneath them.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A partner can observe ground-level light while another adjusts the canopy.

concepts.title: The lichen chronicle
concepts.playerExperience: Cultivate a rock garden whose slowly changing lichen communities record long-term shade, moisture and exposure.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can compare differently exposed gardens through shared observation plates.

concepts.title: The connected aquarium
concepts.playerExperience: Build a living aquarium system of planted basins, filters and species relationships instead of a row of isolated display tanks.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help rearrange approved habitat components and inspect the same flowing system.

concepts.title: The gentle herding language
concepts.playerExperience: Guide a loose group of geese through space using calm gestures and positioning rather than chasing individual animals.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can coordinate their positions to guide the flock through a wide route.

concepts.title: The camouflage observation garden
concepts.playerExperience: Discover how individual creatures alter their appearance and posture across backgrounds, light levels and social situations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can arrange observation backgrounds and compare what each observer notices.

concepts.title: Animals that learn from one another
concepts.playerExperience: Create opportunities for companions to observe and gradually adopt useful behaviors from other compatible animals.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visiting pets can demonstrate learned behaviors without transferring ownership or progression directly.

concepts.title: A companion's own plans
concepts.playerExperience: Notice a pet setting its own small goals and choose whether to join its activity, change the environment or let it proceed alone.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can participate when the companion invites a shared activity.

concepts.title: The hibernation observatory
concepts.playerExperience: Observe a sheltered animal's seasonal rest through a quiet den window and prepare its eventual emergence without daily upkeep pressure.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute observations over a season rather than needing to attend every day.

concepts.title: The amphibian nurseries
concepts.playerExperience: Maintain linked shallow pools and watch tadpoles develop into frogs that gradually move into the surrounding garden.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can tend different pool edges while following the same developing group.

concepts.title: The leafcutter colony
concepts.playerExperience: Observe an ant colony build a transport network and fungal nursery while you supply safe crossings and varied vegetation.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can design alternative crossings and compare which routes the colony adopts.

concepts.title: The living hedge succession
concepts.playerExperience: Develop a layered hedge over several seasons as changing structure supports different nesters, climbers and understory plants.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help with an owner-approved pruning plan and document later habitat changes.

concepts.title: The wildlife rehabilitation reserve
concepts.playerExperience: Care for a small number of temporary wildlife guests through species-specific enrichment before choosing a suitable voluntary release site.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can assist enrichment and prepare the release habitat without punishment for missed visits.

concepts.title: The coastal signal relay
concepts.playerExperience: Operate one station in a chain of shutters and lamps to pass a changing navigational message across the lake.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players must relay information between stations that cannot all see one another.

concepts.title: The rowing crew
concepts.playerExperience: Take a distinct crew role while a shared boat responds to rowing rhythm, steering and load distribution.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can switch roles between rower, navigator and lookout during one trip.

concepts.title: The split field notebooks
concepts.playerExperience: Investigate a shared mystery using observations that are intentionally different in each explorer's field notebook.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players combine complementary evidence through in-world references rather than one player reading every answer.

concepts.title: The traveling theatre company
concepts.playerExperience: Help stage a play by moving sets, operating lighting and performing short scenes on a physical outdoor stage.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The production supports actors, stagehands and a director with separate useful controls.

concepts.title: The canopy bridge riggers
concepts.playerExperience: Work from a tree platform to tension ropes and fit bridge sections into a shared construction that becomes traversable.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Different players hold lines, align sections and secure supports under the owner's authority.

concepts.title: The counterbalanced sculpture workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Control one part of a large balancing machine while shaping a suspended sculpture that changes the machine's load.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Operators must communicate how their adjustments affect the other workstations.

concepts.title: The mapmaker and the walker
concepts.playerExperience: Navigate a changing expedition site while a partner sees its symbolic plan but cannot directly move through it.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The two roles exchange landmarks and instructions through a shared set of clear signals.

concepts.title: The garden ensemble
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange a short composition across several playable instruments with forgiving shared musical timing.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can perform separate parts or schedule accessible phrase-based contributions.

concepts.title: The habitat design council
concepts.playerExperience: Propose a habitat arrangement and see how it interacts with designs made by other gardeners in the same reserve.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The host accepts a combined plan while visitors contribute separate specialist perspectives.

concepts.title: The shared tool library
concepts.playerExperience: Borrow a specialized virtual tool for a planned activity with clear return rules and visible ownership.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can lend tools under limited permissions without copying inventory or requiring both to remain online.

concepts.title: The shared expedition basecamp
concepts.playerExperience: Prepare a persistent expedition hub with maps, equipment choices and routes that remain useful across several group sessions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Returning teams can take over unfinished work without replacing the host's world authority.

concepts.title: The searchlight directors
concepts.playerExperience: Guide a traveler through a theatrical night course using controllable light fields and large environmental signals.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The traveler and light operators have different views and can choose untimed play.

concepts.title: The human-and-companion switchyard
concepts.playerExperience: Use the different movement abilities of a person and companion to deliver a train through a shared mechanical course.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can control separate permitted stations while companions carry out learned local commands.

concepts.title: The distributed relief puzzle
concepts.playerExperience: Restore one panel of a large landscape relief whose mechanisms depend on observations made in other gardens.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players coordinate across hosted gardens without allowing remote visitors to alter private state directly.

concepts.title: The raft expedition
concepts.playerExperience: Keep a shared modular raft stable while choosing a route through currents and distributing useful cargo.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Crew members manage balance, steering and navigation with roles that can be reassigned freely.

concepts.title: The glassblowing team
concepts.playerExperience: Operate one station in a shared glass workshop where heat, turning and air pressure shape a large finished object.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends coordinate furnace, pipe and mold roles through forgiving visible state changes.

concepts.title: The harbor banquet service
concepts.playerExperience: Help run a small lakeside meal service by coordinating cooking, carrying, table layout and the pace of arriving guests.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can divide useful roles without making speed or perfect attendance mandatory.

concepts.title: The archipelago logistics board
concepts.playerExperience: Move boats and shared supplies across a physical island strategy board whose routes change with collective choices.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players plan complementary moves in a cooperative turn structure rather than competing for hidden rewards.

concepts.title: The simultaneous field survey
concepts.playerExperience: Observe one part of a broad natural event while teammates record what happens elsewhere at the same moment.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A shared report combines the distributed observations into a result no single station can provide.

concepts.title: The counterweight adventure
concepts.playerExperience: Explore paired mechanical rooms whose platforms and gates are linked by clearly visible counterweights.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Partners work from different rooms and can pause at safe intermediate configurations.

concepts.title: The scene director and crew
concepts.playerExperience: Create a short garden film while one player frames the camera and others perform or operate scene elements.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A director can cue actions without moving another person's avatar or changing their saved appearance.

concepts.title: The tabletop story garden
concepts.playerExperience: Play an authored adventure on a miniature physical garden board using figures, environmental mechanisms and preset narrative choices.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A host can guide the scenario while friends control their own figures and decisions.

concepts.title: The naturalist charades trail
concepts.playerExperience: Describe a living thing through an agreed vocabulary of gestures, shapes and environmental demonstrations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Teams alternate observer and interpreter roles without needing free-text chat or fast reactions.

concepts.title: The relay of hosts
concepts.playerExperience: Travel through a sequence of friends' gardens where each host prepares a distinct stop in a shared journey.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The route can support both live arrivals and prepared asynchronous visits.

concepts.title: The animal-view partnership
concepts.playerExperience: Experience a contained activity from a small animal's viewpoint while a partner prepares the larger landscape around it.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Both roles retain meaningful choices and can switch perspectives between rounds.

concepts.title: The mosaic mystery exchange
concepts.playerExperience: Restore a local section of an enormous mosaic while discoveries from other gardens change how its remaining pieces are understood.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Participants share bounded pattern information while each owner approves changes to their own section.

concepts.title: The floating night market
concepts.playerExperience: Help operate a moving boat market by connecting docks, unloading cargo and arranging the evening route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can crew different market boats and coordinate their stopping places.

concepts.title: The braided garden paths
concepts.playerExperience: Solve a contained route puzzle where moving an authorized bridge in one garden changes a linked route seen in another.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Partners communicate between complementary hosted spaces with explicit opt-in connections.

concepts.title: The pocket-world nursery
concepts.playerExperience: Maintain one part of a miniature world whose water, shade and growth cycles depend on work done at other stations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players coordinate interdependent ecological roles in a cooperative strategy session.

concepts.title: The in-world makerschool
concepts.playerExperience: Learn a creative technique through a live demonstration and practice it in a separate reversible work area.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A teacher can point, annotate and demonstrate without taking over a learner's controls.

concepts.title: The canal lock system
concepts.playerExperience: Raise and lower a small canal through working locks to reach basins with different shorelines and navigation possibilities.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate gates and signals while the boat remains under one clear authority.

concepts.title: The practical weather station
concepts.playerExperience: Use readable instruments and nearby environmental signs to make forecasts that help plan optional garden activities.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can compare observations from exposed and sheltered stations.

concepts.title: The stream-diversion garden
concepts.playerExperience: Move reversible stream gates to create pools, flowing channels and damp meadows with visibly different inhabitants.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can design branches while the host approves the final water layout.

concepts.title: The shifting estuary bars
concepts.playerExperience: Explore sandbanks whose shapes change with a gentle tidal cycle while boats preserve a reliable route home.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can survey different banks and share current landing information.

concepts.title: The rain-garden chain
concepts.playerExperience: Shape connected infiltration beds and watch rainfall travel from roofs through pools, soil and planted swales.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help tune separate sections of the same visible water journey.

concepts.title: Snow-load engineering
concepts.playerExperience: Adjust the angles and supports of garden structures so snow collects into useful sheltered shapes without destroying anything.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can inspect loads from different sides and propose reversible structural changes.

concepts.title: The frost-weave trellis
concepts.playerExperience: Guide water along a trellis to grow temporary frost structures whose branching patterns reveal safe little passages.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can control separate water feeds and compare the resulting shapes.

concepts.title: The mist-harvest network
concepts.playerExperience: Position mesh catchers and channels so passing mist supplies a connected hanging garden through visible droplets and flow.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can compare catcher positions and manage different branches of the distribution system.

concepts.title: The thermal spring garden
concepts.playerExperience: Mix warm and cool spring channels to shape circulation patterns that support different aquatic planting arrangements.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate source controls while another observes the circulation basin.

concepts.title: The floating rain-season walkways
concepts.playerExperience: Adapt a floodplain garden with anchored floating paths and raised beds as optional seasonal water levels rise.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help reposition approved anchors while the host retains a safe permanent access route.

concepts.title: Wind-shadow gardening
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange permeable screens and vegetation to create useful wind corridors for plants and moving garden mechanisms.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can observe different wind zones while one player adjusts a screen.

concepts.title: Storm-exposure photography
concepts.playerExperience: Use a controllable long-exposure camera to capture how lightning illuminates a landscape without putting the player in danger.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can coordinate camera positions and visible exposure signals.

concepts.title: The snowmelt irrigation calendar
concepts.playerExperience: Guide gradual snowmelt through reversible channels to reveal and water different garden terraces over spring.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can maintain sections of the same slow seasonal water system.

concepts.title: The living shoreline workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Use planted edges and porous barriers to guide sediment into coves, reed beds and calm boat landings.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can compare proposed shore sections before the owner commits a layout.

concepts.title: The water-power grid
concepts.playerExperience: Route flow through working wheels and mechanical transmissions to power different garden installations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate branches and observe how the connected mechanisms share available power.

concepts.title: The layered lake observatory
concepts.playerExperience: Read temperature and depth instruments to understand changing layers of water and where different lake life chooses to gather.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Boaters can take measurements at different depths and combine them into one cross-section.

concepts.title: The estuary salinity garden
concepts.playerExperience: Blend fresh and tidal water in a contained estuary and discover which plants and animals settle along its gradient.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can tend complementary zones and share observations of the moving boundary.

concepts.title: The seasonal lake turnover
concepts.playerExperience: Observe a lake's seasonal mixing through visible clarity, circulation and changing wildlife routes.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can record the event from several shoreline stations.

concepts.title: The rooftop water route
concepts.playerExperience: Design a network of gutters, tipping vessels and downpipes that turns real garden rainfall into a visible mechanical journey.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A partner can monitor the lower route while another changes a roof connection.

concepts.title: The lighthouse weather desk
concepts.playerExperience: Plan safe optional shoreline journeys using a working lighthouse desk that combines visibility, wave exposure and landing information.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can report conditions from observation posts along the planned route.

concepts.title: The seasonal ground mosaic
concepts.playerExperience: Develop meadow patches whose moisture and seasonal growth gradually reshape the open routes between them.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can contribute observations and help maintain an owner-approved route.

concepts.title: The rainbow optics workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Build a working arrangement of water jets and prisms to understand and paint with separated sunlight.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can adjust different optical elements and compare the resulting projection.

concepts.title: The miniature glacier table
concepts.playerExperience: Shape a contained model landscape and watch compressed seasonal cycles carve its valleys with ice and meltwater.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can propose different terrain interventions and compare reversible model runs.

concepts.title: The under-ice ecology window
concepts.playerExperience: Maintain an observation window beneath a frozen pond and follow the quiet seasonal life below its surface.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can annotate different depths and compare observations across winter visits.

concepts.title: The drifting garden gyre
concepts.playerExperience: Create anchored floating gardens that move through a slow lake current and form changing connections between docks.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can coordinate moorings and meet when their floating plots come alongside.

concepts.title: The dew-lens laboratory
concepts.playerExperience: Use dew droplets on carefully positioned leaves as tiny lenses that project readable patterns onto a nearby observation plate.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can arrange leaves and record projections from different positions.

concepts.title: The solar pond heat store
concepts.playerExperience: Collect daytime warmth in a layered garden pond and distribute it through visible channels during cool evenings.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can operate collection and distribution stations as separate roles.

concepts.title: The underwater sound survey
concepts.playerExperience: Lower hydrophones into a lake and use spatial sound or equivalent visual notation to map activity hidden below the surface.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Boat crews can compare simultaneous recordings from different listening points.

concepts.title: The brine crystal garden
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange shallow evaporation basins and watch season, shade and flow create large patterned mineral structures.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can maintain comparison basins and assemble a shared crystal exhibition.

concepts.title: The phenology observatory
concepts.playerExperience: Build a living seasonal forecast from observed budding, insect emergence and flowering in the actual garden.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends in different garden climates can compare their seasonal sequences without competing on dates.

concepts.title: The living hedge cathedral
concepts.playerExperience: Train compatible living arches into an explorable structure whose chambers continue growing around your design.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can design adjoining bays while the owner approves the shared plan.

concepts.title: The braided tree bridge
concepts.playerExperience: Guide living roots and branches across a gap until they form a durable garden bridge with visible growth stages.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can tend opposite banks and agree on the bridge's shape.

concepts.title: The topiary theatre
concepts.playerExperience: Sculpt a connected arrangement of living forms whose openings and silhouettes create a walk-through theatrical scene.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can perform within the finished scene or contribute approved sculpting suggestions.

concepts.title: The pneumatic garden post
concepts.playerExperience: Build a transparent tube network and route virtual parcels through it with bellows, valves and branching stations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate separate terminals and coordinate deliveries within the hosted garden.

concepts.title: The discovery relief mural
concepts.playerExperience: Create a large physical map whose raised forms and chosen details grow into a personal record of explored places.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can inspect the relief and leave owner-approved symbolic contributions.

concepts.title: The contour landforming studio
concepts.playerExperience: Sculpt bounded terrain contours and preview the resulting paths, drainage and sightlines before committing a reversible change.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can propose edits on separate layers without changing the host's terrain directly.

concepts.title: The modular roof workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Construct a building from compatible structural pieces so its exterior, interior volume and usable entrances match.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can co-design a blueprint while one owner authorizes placement and materials.

concepts.title: The clockwork workbench
concepts.playerExperience: Connect gears, cams and linkages into working garden mechanisms with visible motion and understandable inputs.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate different inputs and help diagnose a mechanism through observation.

concepts.title: The composing music-box workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange a bounded mechanical score and build an instrument that performs your composition in the world.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute parts or listen through their own sound and sensory preferences.

concepts.title: The origami pavilion workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Fold structural paper models and expand successful designs into walkable temporary pavilions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can coordinate folds and inspect the model from different sides.

concepts.title: The perspective path studio
concepts.playerExperience: Build an installation whose disconnected forms appear to join from chosen viewpoints and reveal a navigable route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can guide an observer toward the intended perspective without changing their camera directly.

concepts.title: The stained-glass garden
concepts.playerExperience: Design glass panels whose colors and shapes cast changing compositions across a real garden floor.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can assemble panel sections and compare the combined projection.

concepts.title: The balanced kinetic mobiles
concepts.playerExperience: Build large wind-driven sculptures by balancing mass, pivot placement and moving forms instead of choosing a preset animation.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can add proposed parts and observe how the balance changes.

concepts.title: The woven habitat workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Weave flexible structures that become functional nesting walls, climbing surfaces or planted partitions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can work on distinct sections of a shared pattern.

concepts.title: The ceramic kiln studio
concepts.playerExperience: Shape useful ceramic objects and choose a firing and cooling process that produces readable material differences.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can coordinate a shared kiln load while retaining ownership of their individual pieces.

concepts.title: The growing moss drawings
concepts.playerExperience: Compose a large moss drawing whose pattern slowly changes according to the moisture and shade you provide.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can help tend approved parts without repainting the owner's design.

concepts.title: The shadow-puppet machinery
concepts.playerExperience: Build articulated figures and lighting arrangements that project a controllable story onto a garden wall.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate puppets, light and scenery as distinct performance roles.

concepts.title: The garden dye loom
concepts.playerExperience: Develop plant-based palettes and weave large patterned textiles from a readable physical loom plan.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can exchange pattern proposals and coordinate separate loom controls.

concepts.title: The acoustic landscape studio
concepts.playerExperience: Shape a listening space through material, geometry and placement so water, footsteps and instruments respond to its structure.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can compare listening positions using audio or an equivalent visual representation.

concepts.title: The garden automata workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Build small mechanical figures whose constrained cam routines interact with clearly defined garden props.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can demonstrate routines or contribute approved components without granting unrestricted automation.

concepts.title: The optical instrument workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Assemble useful surveying instruments from lenses and marked scales, then use them for actual spatial observations.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can take complementary measurements and compare their assembled instruments.

concepts.title: The marble-run garden
concepts.playerExperience: Construct a persistent outdoor marble course with lifts, switches and water-driven elements that can be operated as a machine.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can control branches or design adjoining course sections.

concepts.title: The mechanical drawing machines
concepts.playerExperience: Connect simple drawing mechanisms to produce large bounded geometric artworks from your chosen motion relationships.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can operate separate controls during a shared drawing performance.

concepts.title: The snow architecture archive
concepts.playerExperience: Design substantial seasonal snow structures whose saved plans can be rebuilt even after the physical snow melts.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can construct compatible rooms and preserve a shared plan with owner approval.

concepts.title: The rope-and-pulley cranes
concepts.playerExperience: Rig a working crane to place large sculptural pieces through deliberate lifting and balancing decisions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can handle guide ropes, counterweights and placement signals.

concepts.title: The cloth canopy studio
concepts.playerExperience: Design the supports and tension of a broad fabric installation, then see how it changes wind and light underneath.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can adjust separate supports and inspect the resulting structure.

concepts.title: The player-curated exhibitions
concepts.playerExperience: Build a walk-through exhibit that explains a garden story through arranged objects, diagrams and chosen observation viewpoints.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can tour together and contribute explicitly permitted exhibit pieces.

concepts.title: The nature-print darkroom
concepts.playerExperience: Compose botanical contact prints and develop them through controllable light, masking and washing stages.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can prepare different masks and combine their prints into a shared display.

concepts.title: The clay stop-motion studio
concepts.playerExperience: Shape a small articulated character and make a short garden film by arranging and recording clear physical poses.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can divide animation, camera and set-building work.

concepts.title: The kaleidoscope pavilion
concepts.playerExperience: Arrange mirrors and patterned screens inside an explorable pavilion that transforms selected garden views into geometric compositions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can choose different viewing stations and coordinate the pavilion's movable elements.

concepts.title: The traveling surveyor
concepts.playerExperience: Work with a recurring surveyor whose commissions reveal how actual player-made landscape changes alter routes and views.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute measurements and compare the surveyor's maps of their gardens.

concepts.title: The village parade route
concepts.playerExperience: Plan a moving celebration through restored places, balancing route width, stopping points and the needs of its participants.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can perform, steward a junction or operate a parade installation.

concepts.title: The island settlement
concepts.playerExperience: Develop a small remote settlement through useful facilities and recurring relationships that change what residents can do.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute to owner-approved development without replacing local decisions.

concepts.title: The artisan apprenticeships
concepts.playerExperience: Learn a profession through hands-on commissions that introduce new game verbs rather than only increasing item statistics.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A skilled visitor can demonstrate a technique in a separate practice workspace.

concepts.title: The village planning council
concepts.playerExperience: Negotiate a physical village plan by understanding residents' different access, habitat and gathering needs.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can submit proposals while the owner makes the final reversible planning choice.

concepts.title: Character home visits
concepts.playerExperience: Visit lived-in character homes whose activities and useful interactions change with their ongoing stories.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can join an invited visit and take complementary roles in a household activity.

concepts.title: The traveling library
concepts.playerExperience: Circulate virtual illustrated books whose journeys accumulate bounded garden observations before returning to their home shelf.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute approved observations without exposing unrelated dashboard data.

concepts.title: The mobile workshop caravan
concepts.playerExperience: Help an artisan move a functioning workshop between remote job sites and adapt its tools to the work found there.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can prepare the route and operate different workshop stations.

concepts.title: The village mystery hearings
concepts.playerExperience: Resolve gentle village disputes by gathering environmental evidence and presenting a clear explanation that changes a shared place.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can investigate separate leads and compare interpretations before the owner chooses an outcome.

concepts.title: The neighborhood routines
concepts.playerExperience: Design useful public routes and places, then watch recognizable residents build their daily lives around the resulting layout.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can accompany residents or propose better connections without controlling their behavior directly.

concepts.title: The garden household
concepts.playerExperience: Develop a functional home whose rooms support distinct shared activities and relationships instead of serving only as decoration storage.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Invited friends can use permitted rooms and participate in household activities.

concepts.title: The regional garden exchanges
concepts.playerExperience: Host fictional gardeners from different climates and learn their practical approaches through activities adapted to your own landscape.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can compare adapted designs and arrange reciprocal hosted activities.

concepts.title: The local newspaper workshop
concepts.playerExperience: Create an illustrated village paper from confirmed garden events, interviews and diagrams through a physical editorial workflow.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute approved reports or illustrations and assemble an issue together.

concepts.title: Friendship through shared activities
concepts.playerExperience: Learn a character's habits through meaningful joint activities that open new ways to interact with them and the world.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can participate when the character's activity supports a group without receiving another player's private story state.

concepts.title: The village preparedness rehearsals
concepts.playerExperience: Plan and rehearse calm evacuation and supply routes in a contained village exercise where mistakes are reversible and nobody is harmed.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can guide groups, operate access points or observe route bottlenecks.

concepts.title: The landscape croquet club
concepts.playerExperience: Play a complete outdoor croquet game on terrain-aware courses that players can design and residents can learn.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can play doubles or collaborate on a fair course layout.

concepts.title: The school field trips
concepts.playerExperience: Prepare an engaging route for a small fictional school group and teach through real garden observations and interactive stops.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can act as guides at different stops or accompany the group.

concepts.title: The village transit network
concepts.playerExperience: Connect useful village destinations through a modest working transport network with readable stops and schedules.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can operate services or help plan connections while the owner controls persistent infrastructure.

concepts.title: The walkable memory scenes
concepts.playerExperience: Enter a character's carefully staged recollection and compare its garden with the present to understand a personal mystery.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Invited companions can observe complementary details without changing another player's completed story.

concepts.title: The workshop succession
concepts.playerExperience: Help an established artisan teach a successor, choosing which traditions and new capabilities their shared workshop will preserve.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can assist practical commissions while the host chooses the workshop's direction.

concepts.title: The public seed bank
concepts.playerExperience: Curate a living conservation collection whose useful diversity depends on documented growing conditions and thoughtful propagation.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Gardeners can exchange identified accessions under clear ownership and permission rules.

concepts.title: Player-made seasonal rituals
concepts.playerExperience: Create a recurring local celebration from chosen places, actions and meanings rather than selecting a preset festival skin.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can accept specific roles and contribute parts while attendance remains optional.

concepts.title: Character expedition partners
concepts.playerExperience: Invite a resident on an expedition where their interests and practical knowledge reveal different interactions along the route.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can bring complementary guides without multiplying mandatory chores.

concepts.title: The conservation charters
concepts.playerExperience: Choose how a special area is cared for through a clear charter that affects access, building choices and future wildlife activity.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Visitors can take limited caretaker roles chosen by the owner.

concepts.title: The village radio station
concepts.playerExperience: Program a fictional local broadcast from field recordings, music and confirmed village events through an in-world studio.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can contribute approved segments or perform a shared broadcast.

concepts.title: The language of the garden
concepts.playerExperience: Learn an invented visual language through character activities and use it to interpret optional inscriptions and places.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can compare contextual evidence and help translate longer messages without requiring free-text chat.

concepts.title: Sound-first expeditions
concepts.playerExperience: Explore complete routes through spatial audio landmarks and an equivalent semantic map without relying on small visual details.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A partner can share named landmarks through accessible in-world signals.

concepts.title: Comfort-aware route planning
concepts.playerExperience: Choose routes that respect your preferences for narrow passages, heights, busy spaces and travel pace without losing essential content.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can plan a mutually suitable route before starting an activity.

concepts.title: The raised-relief wayfinding table
concepts.playerExperience: Explore a keyboard-readable physical model of the garden that explains connections, elevation and reachable interactions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can refer to the same named locations from different viewpoints.

concepts.title: The single-control companion interface
concepts.playerExperience: Express high-level movement and tool intentions through a small input vocabulary while retaining meaningful choices in puzzles and exploration.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A trusted companion player can assist only with explicitly shared controls.

concepts.title: The shared cadence buffer
concepts.playerExperience: Participate in cooperative timing activities by queuing understandable actions onto a forgiving shared sequence.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Different input speeds can contribute to the same activity without changing its canonical outcome rules.

concepts.title: The garden sensory notation
concepts.playerExperience: Learn a consistent visible and spoken notation for environmental sounds so audio-based discoveries remain fully playable through other senses.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can communicate with the same semantic cues regardless of their chosen presentation.

concepts.title: The semantic exploration guide
concepts.playerExperience: Receive concise descriptions of nearby routes, obstacles and meaningful changes while exploring at your own pace.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A friend can point to a named world object without moving another player's camera.

concepts.title: The exploration rehearsal theatre
concepts.playerExperience: Practice an unfamiliar route or mechanism in a clearly separate reversible model before choosing to attempt it in the world.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can rehearse complementary roles without awarding progression for practice outcomes.

concepts.title: The assisted creative drawing studio
concepts.playerExperience: Create substantial garden designs through shape intentions, constraints and adjustable guides instead of requiring steady pointer drawing.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Partners can offer separate editable suggestions while the creator keeps control.

concepts.title: The shared read-along routes
concepts.playerExperience: Experience a story walk with synchronized place references and individually controlled reading or listening pace.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can remain together while advancing their own narration and subtitles independently.

concepts.title: The semantic world focus system
concepts.playerExperience: Move focus through actual world objects in a logical spatial order and perform their full interactions from the keyboard or controller.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Shared object names let friends coordinate without relying on identical screen coordinates.

concepts.title: The icon storybook adventures
concepts.playerExperience: Follow complete optional adventures through a taught visual grammar with spoken and text equivalents rather than language-heavy instructions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players using different interface languages can refer to the same story symbols.

concepts.title: Motion-free kinetic play
concepts.playerExperience: Play movement-dependent activities through deliberate discrete states and clear predictions while preserving their meaningful decisions.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: The same shared activity can offer different local presentations under one authoritative logical sequence.

concepts.title: Personal memory landmarks
concepts.playerExperience: Place private, persistent semantic landmarks that help you recognize places and recall unfinished intentions without adding public clutter.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Players can explicitly share selected landmarks when planning a group route.

concepts.title: Strategy alternatives to precision
concepts.playerExperience: Choose fully designed decision-based alternatives for selected precision activities instead of merely bypassing them or granting automatic success.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Friends can use equivalent activity roles with outcomes governed by the same accepted rules.

concepts.title: The conversation map
concepts.playerExperience: Revisit heard clues and character relationships through a spatial conversation record that preserves context without revealing unearned answers.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group can share only the clues each participant deliberately chooses to discuss.

concepts.title: The readable world lighting
concepts.playerExperience: Use a coherent local lighting and outline treatment that keeps people, tools and active objects legible beneath dense scenery.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Every player keeps their own legibility treatment while sharing the same physical world.

concepts.title: The gesture command navigation
concepts.playerExperience: Use a consistent controller or pointer gesture language for travel, camera work and garden actions without navigating many small controls.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Semantic action signals remain understandable to friends using different input methods.

concepts.title: Tandem copilot play
concepts.playerExperience: Explicitly divide camera, navigation or tool assistance with a trusted player while preserving your ownership of decisions and saved progress.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: Each shared control has a visible scope and can be handed back immediately.

concepts.title: Activity playstyles
concepts.playerExperience: Switch between saved combinations of input, sensory presentation and pacing appropriate to exploration, creation or social play.
concepts.multiplayerOpportunity: A group activity can respect each participant's local playstyle without forcing identical settings.
